theme: 个股·港股行情与财务：腾讯控股年报/中报营业额与最新行情，香港交易所估值与市值

initial.question: 我组合里配了腾讯控股，先看下它2025年年报的营业额有多大？
initial.gold_display: 7517.66亿元（人民币，腾讯以人民币列报）
initial.gold_sql: SELECT n.TTO FROM HK_NFINIS_NSTD n JOIN HK_STKCODE c ON n.COMUNIC=c.COMUNIC WHERE c.STKCODE='00700' AND c.ISVALID=1 AND n.EDATE='2025-12-31' AND n.RPTSOUREFC=17

feedbacks.question: 它现在股价什么水平？给我最新一个交易日的收盘价。
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT CLPR FROM HK_STKDMK WHERE STKUNICODE=(SELECT STKUNICODE FROM HK_STKCODE WHERE STKCODE='00700' AND ISVALID=1) ORDER BY TRDATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 那当天成交额有多大？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT TRTO FROM HK_STKDMK WHERE STKUNICODE=(SELECT STKUNICODE FROM HK_STKCODE WHERE STKCODE='00700' AND ISVALID=1) AND TRDATE=(SELECT MAX(TRDATE) FROM HK_STKDMK WHERE STKUNICODE=(SELECT STKUNICODE FROM HK_STKCODE WHERE STKCODE='00700' AND ISVALID=1))

feedbacks.question: 2026年中报已经出来了，它上半年的营业额是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT n.TTO FROM HK_NFINIS_NSTD n JOIN HK_STKCODE c ON n.COMUNIC=c.COMUNIC WHERE c.STKCODE='00700' AND c.ISVALID=1 AND n.EDATE='2026-06-30' AND n.RPTSOUREFC=15

feedbacks.question: 再帮我看个港股，香港交易所最新的市净率是多少？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT v.PB FROM HK_IDC_STKVIDC v JOIN HK_STKCODE c ON v.STKUNICODE=c.STKUNICODE WHERE c.STKCODE='00388' AND c.ISVALID=1 ORDER BY v.EDATE DESC LIMIT 1

feedbacks.question: 它现在的总市值有多大？
feedbacks.gold_sql: SELECT p.TMKCAP FROM HK_IDC_STKPFMIDC p JOIN HK_STKCODE c ON p.STKUNICODE=c.STKUNICODE WHERE c.STKCODE='00388' AND c.ISVALID=1 ORDER BY p.EDATE DESC LIMIT 1
